title: Summa Theologica
author: aquinas
attributionNote: Completed and supplemented by Aquinas's students after his death in 1274; the Supplement is not from his hand.
description: Aquinas's systematic theology, arranged as questions and articles. Each article states objections, a counter-argument, a determination and replies. Part I treats God and creation, I-II and II-II the moral life, III the incarnation and sacraments; the Supplement gathers material on penance and last things.
historicalContext: Written while Aquinas taught at Rome and Paris, as a teaching text for beginners. He stopped work in December 1273; the Supplement was compiled after his death.
availabilityNote: Streamed from New Advent at read time. The English is the 1920 revision of the Fathers of the English Dominican Province translation; the Latin is not hosted in this edition.

editions.attributionText: The Summa Theologica of St. Thomas Aquinas, literally translated by Fathers of the English Dominican Province, second and revised edition (1920). Public domain. Digital text served by New Advent.
editions.notes: Each passage is one article: its heading, objections, counter-argument, determination and replies, as New Advent presents them. New Advent's online edition carries its own copyright notice; this library links to and credits that edition rather than copying it.
